title: Book Two · Chapter 102: Two Doors
story:
After lunch, Ronan and Jun return to the passage. A small boy stands outside the reading room. He has a large empty bag.

“Can I take a book home?” the boy asks.

“From that room,” Jun says. He points to the next door.

The boy looks at both signs. “They both have books.”

Ronan moves to the materials room door. There is a shelf inside, but the door is locked now. A paper holder hangs beside it. The front sheet gives the name of the room. The lower corner is folded back.

“We are making a guide,” Ronan says. “It will explain this.”

“When can I get it?”

“Soon.”

Jun touches Ronan's arm. “We need to finish the checks.”

The boy leaves. His empty bag knocks against his legs.

Ronan takes the loose paper from the holder. Behind it is an older sheet with large black letters. WEDNESDAY AFTER LUNCH. Under the words is a list of books and picture sheets.

“Here,” Ronan says. “This is the time.”

Jun looks at the lower edge. A brown mark covers part of the paper.

“Is it for this term?”

“It is on this door.”

“It is behind another sheet.”

Ronan holds both papers together. The front sheet has no opening time. The old one does. He copies Wednesday into his notebook. He adds a small question mark beside it.

“We can ask the teacher,” Jun says.

The teacher in charge is in a lesson now. Miss Wu is with another group. Jun needs to return to his own class.

“I can check tomorrow,” Ronan says.

“All the times?”

“Yes. You can do the list of books.”

They divide the work on the table that afternoon. Jun writes the book list on his page. Ronan writes TIMES on another. Mei brings the route picture, still in pencil.

“Which room is which?” she asks.

Jun shows her his two squares. She adds two clear signs beside the doors. Then she puts her pencil away.

“I will make the lines dark tomorrow,” she says. “Do you need anything else on my picture?”

Ronan points to the room with books to take home. “Could you put the hours here?”

Mei shakes her head. “Put those in your words. Hours can change.”

Jun nods. Ronan puts his notebook on the empty cover. The question mark sits beside Wednesday. It is smaller than the word, but it is still there.

Before class, he folds the old sheet and puts it in his bag. He plans to show it to the teacher tomorrow.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

locked＝锁着的；opening time＝开放时间；in charge＝负责的；question mark＝问号。

## 理解问题

1. Jun为什么怀疑周三时间？
2. Mei为什么不把时间写进图里？

## 读句子

**The boy / leaves.** 男孩／离开。
